title: Junior Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Junior Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team at Amazon. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment
